protocol: SG paired-frame initialization comparison, frozen before new training
authorization: The user authorized subsequent computations and quality refinements on 2026-09-24.
initialization: PCG64(seed), draw L/2 radii uniformly on [0.3,0.8], then L/2 phases uniformly on [0,2pi). Adjacent displacements are beta and minus beta. First SNAP has arg(diag(U_target)) on all active levels; other SNAP phases and common phase are zero.
objective: Unchanged common-phase uniform first-16-column action MSE plus 1e-8 mean displacement magnitude squared.
optimizer: Unchanged SLSQP, maxiter=1200, ftol=1e-12, original phase and component bounds. Record iteration loss without additional objective calls.
selection: Minimum training objective within each r,L. Evaluate all six selected circuits before any further adjustment.
independent_evaluation_rule: The second coherent preparation is declared before refinement and is not evaluated during tuning. After final development selection, evaluate the fixed representative H_trig r10 order2 s1 and G_trig r20 order1/order2 s1, plus the least-primitive passing H_SNAP if any. Evaluate once at 128/160 without retuning.
acceptance: Identical to the formal SG comparison: state amplitude sqrt(1e-3), reference and solver resolutions sqrt(1e-3)/10, boundary 1e-6, C12 total 0.01 and uncertainty 0.001, S2 total 0.02 and uncertainty 0.005.
conditional_followup: If no circuit passes, inspect same-parameter training-cutoff consistency and primitive populations first. A further bounded training-space or depth comparison must be recorded separately before execution. Lack of improvement under a finite search does not prove insufficient ansatz capacity.
